components.name: History Service
components.quote: History Service shards manage individual [Workflow Executions]

components.name: Matching Service
components.quote: The Matching Service manages the [Task Queues]

components.name: Temporal Worker
components.quote: hosts [Worker](https://docs.temporal.io/workers) processes, which execute their Workflow and Activity code

components.name: User Application
components.quote: The User Application uses one of the [Temporal SDKs]

relations.quote: drive the Workflow Execution to completion by enqueuing Workflow and Activity Tasks in the Matching Service
they continuously poll the server for Workflow and Activity tasks, and on completion of each task they send information to the server.
Temporal Workers poll the Task Queues in the Matching service for tasks.

The User Application uses one of the [Temporal SDKs](https://docs.temporal.io/dev-guide) as a gRPC client to communicate with the Temporal server to start/cancel workflows, and interact with running workflows.
